result.topic_en: Opening of Euler's paper on the height of columns that collapse under their own weight, recalling his earlier differential equation and series solution for the bent column and the mistaken conclusion that column height could be increased indefinitely.

items.english: this circumstance had, as it were, misled me into thinking that the height of columns could thus be increased indefinitely without danger of breaking.
